title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 132 ]

blocks.text: Language purists wish to stem change in language or dialect differentiation because of their false belief that some languages are better than others, or that change leads to corruption.

readingSentences.english: Language purists wish to stem change in language or dialect differentiation because of their false belief that some languages are better than others, or that change leads to corruption.
readingSentences.korean: 언어 순수학자는 일부 언어가 다른 언어보다 낫거나 변화가 오염이 된다는 거릇된 믿음 때문에 언어의 변화나 방언의 차이를 저지하기를 원한다.
